newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs seen hesitant before 5.75 pct level.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs seen hesitant before 5.75 pct level.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures opened lower with Bunds on Thursday ahead of a series of U.S. indicators, including April CPI, seen at 2.6 percent year-on-year.
CPI and jobless claims are due at 1230 GMT, followed by U.S. industrial production and capacity utilisation at 1315.
Dealers said they expected the market to tread water ahead of the U.S. data and saw 5.75 percent as a strong technical level for 10-year paper.
"There are a lot of people ready to take profits, I do not think 5.75 will be easy to break," one dealer said.
The 10-year OLO yielded 5.78 percent in early trade, from 5.77 percent on Wednesday, an unchanged 10 bp over Bunds.
The Belgian franc continued its recovery, easing away from the 20.64 to the mark level.
"Nobody understood why it had weakened towards 20.64 to the mark in the first place," one dealer said. By 0800 GMT it was quoted 20.6388/97.

Dealers said the market was eagerly awaiting the launch of Belgian futures and options exchange Belfox' medium-term future on Friday. -- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
